properties.notes: Redevelopment of land within the urban area through infill development. The site was previously occupied by a industrial workshop but this has been cleared. An outline permission for 9 units was permitted but this lapsed without commencement (15/01774/OUT). It is understood that the site has now been sold and a residential scheme is not to be progressed at the current time. However, long-term potential could remain and the site will remain on the BF Register. The relatively high yield identified reflects development at an increased density, reflecting the location and nature of a likely flatted scheme.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
